description: Keeps every pinned version current (ADR-0020): Go modules, GitHub Actions, the Dockerfile, the chart's images and the tools the Makefile pins. `make renovate-check` validates this file and dry-runs it.

customManagers.description:
A `# renovate: datasource= depName= [packageName=

] [versioning=] [registryUrl=]` comment pins the version on the next line: the value after its first `:=`, `=` or `:`.

packageRules.description: Go modules, minor and patch, in one PR
The Go toolchain: go.mod's go and toolchain lines and the Dockerfile's golang image together
The images the chart's values pin, in one PR
The tools the Makefile pins, in one PR
Playwright: the Makefile's image tag (PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION) and the stand-in UI test's @playwright/test must stay equal, so they move in one PR
oidc-client-ts: the stand-in UI ships its browser bundle in site/vendor; the browser test fails until `make stand-in-ui-vendor` is run and committed in the same PR
prBodyNotes: Run `make stand-in-ui-vendor` and commit `deploy/helm/wallet-accountant/test/stand-in-ui/site/vendor` before merging.
